_comment: Bands for scripts/bank-check.js. Each is derived from the bank mode spec (project_plan.md in the Betaflight repo), not from a measured run. Same rule as tests/thresholds.json: never widen a band to make a check pass; argue it in PROGRESS.md and let the owner decide. A key with no band here is printed as info.

hover_vertical_accel.why: pitch stick centre is 1 g of lift: zero vertical acceleration (not zero vertical speed, that needs baro)

hover_tilt_deg.why: speed stick at the bottom: no tilt

hover_horizontal_speed.why: speed stick at the bottom commands zero speed

cruise_speed_variation.why: a fixed speed stick holds a steady speed once settled

cruise_vertical_accel.why: tilting forward raises collective by 1/cos so vertical force is unchanged

turn_roll_tracking_deg.why: the craft holds the bank angle the mode commands

turn_ball_g.why: the ball loop nulls lateral specific force in a steady turn

turn_coordination_dps.why: coordinated turn: the nose turns at the rate the track turns

turn_vertical_accel.why: bank applies the same 1/cos tilt compensation

headcheck_nose_offset_deg.why: full right roll stick yaws the nose head_check_range (90 deg) clockwise of the track

headcheck_track_change_deg.why: head check must not change the direction of travel

headreturn_nose_offset_deg.why: head check springs back to neutral when the stick centres

brake_final_speed.why: speed stick to the bottom brakes to a stop

mode_off_cleared.why: switching bank off clears the mode

determinism_same_hash.why: same inputs give a bit identical trace
